locations.note: Sam revives in Capital Knot City after Central Knot City is destroyed, delivers morphine to the dying President Bridget Strand and sets off west; the story ends back here, at the incinerator outside the city, where he decides Lou's fate.
Sam crosses what is left of the contiguous United States on foot, delivering cargo between knot cities and preppers' shelters through Timefall and BT territory.
The last city on the west coast, where the terrorists of Homo Demens hold Amelie; Sam defeats Higgs on Amelie's Beach.

routes.name: Sam Porter Bridges
routes.note: East coast to west coast, then back to Capital Knot City for the ending.
